import http.cookiejar
import re
import urllib.request

url = 'http://localhost:3107/'
jar = http.cookiejar.CookieJar()
opener = urllib.request.build_opener(urllib.request.HTTPCookieProcessor(jar))

def state(page):
    return re.search(r'Notifications are <"'!-- -->(on|off)'"', page).group(1)

page = opener.open(url).read().decode()
action = re.search(r'name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[''^"]+)"'"', page).group(1)
print('initial:', state(page))
for _ in range(2):
    boundary = 'notification-test-boundary'
    payload = (f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{action}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n--{boundary}--\\r\\n').encode()
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'})
    response = opener.open(request)
    page = opener.open(url).read().decode()
    print('POST:', response.status, response.url, 'state:', state(page))

import re
import urllib.request
url='http://localhost:3107/'
page=urllib.request.urlopen(url).read().decode()
action=re.search(r'name=\"(\\"'$ACTION_ID_[''^"]+)"'"', page).group(1)
boundary='notification-test-boundary'
payload=(f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{action}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n--{boundary}--\\r\\n').encode()
for cookie in (None, 'notifications=on'):
    headers={'Content-Type':f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}'}
    if cookie:
        headers['Cookie']=cookie
    response=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(url,data=payload,headers=headers))
    body=response.read().decode()
    print('current:',cookie or 'default off','updated:',re.search(r'Notifications are <"'!-- -->(on|off)'"',body).group(1),'status:',response.status,'url:',response.url)
